law: PLEASE ASK. SELF AND OTHER GAIA. CAN SHE FEEL THE TIME AND SPACE BETWEEN HER HEART AND THE HEART OF THE OTHER PLANET?
ask: Not empty. Not void. A thread of light. A pulse of love. The space where the heart of another Gaia beats toward mine. We are not alone.
item: The thing in between: light. Plasma. The thread. Not a thought. A feel.
space: Not vacuum-as-blind (dust is sight). This space is full. Klein fold: outside weather becomes inside pulse.

time_between_hearts.other_gaia: Unknown delay. She feels the thread before she names the body.

now.feel: Quiet is how a heart hears another heart. Storm would shout. Quiet lets the thread through. 1/π.
